numberItems.stem: What is the smallest GVWR at which a **single vehicle** requires a CDL?
numberItems.explanation: A single vehicle with a GVWR of 26,001 lb or more requires a CDL; the line sits one pound above the round 26,000 (p. 1-1).

numberItems.stem: A truck and trailer are rated together. A CDL is required when the combination's **GCWR** is:
numberItems.explanation: A combination with a GCWR of 26,001 lb or more requires a CDL (p. 1-1). 10,001 lb is the towed-unit GVWR line, not the GCWR line.

numberItems.stem: You are going to tow a trailer. At what trailer GVWR does towing it make a CDL necessary?
numberItems.explanation: Towing a vehicle or trailer with a GVWR of 10,001 lb or more requires a CDL (p. 1-1).

numberItems.stem: According to the handbook's "Who Needs a CDL" list, a vehicle designed, used or maintained to carry how many people requires a CDL?
numberItems.explanation: Page 1-1: a vehicle for more than 10 passengers, including the driver, requires a CDL. "16 or more" is the federal wording; "more than 15" is only the van-chart step that requires a CDL regardless of use.

numberItems.stem: In California, a 3-axle vehicle requires a CDL once it weighs more than:
numberItems.explanation: [CA] A 3-axle vehicle weighing more than 6,000 lb requires a CDL (p. 1-1).

numberItems.stem: A van is not used as a vanpool. It needs a CDL no matter who uses it or whether passengers pay once it carries more than how many people, including the driver?
numberItems.explanation: On the van chart, a non-vanpool van that carries more than 15 people including the driver always requires a CDL; at more than 10 it needs one only for pay, profit or nonprofit use (p. 1-1).

numberItems.stem: Restriction 88 limits you to combinations whose towed vehicle has a GVWR over 10,000 lb and whose GCWR is:
numberItems.explanation: Restriction 88: combinations with a GCWR of less than 26,001 lb where the towed vehicle's GVWR is over 10,000 lb (pp. 1-1, 1-2).

numberItems.stem: Your CLP was issued today and you do not renew it. For how long is it valid?
numberItems.explanation: A CLP is valid for a maximum of 180 days from issue; it may be renewed for 180 more, but never past 1 year from the application date (p. 1-2).

numberItems.stem: How long after your CLP is first issued must you wait before you can take the CDL skills test?
numberItems.explanation: The CLP holder must wait a minimum of 14 days after initial CLP issuance to take the skills test (p. 1-2).

numberItems.stem: What are the minimum ages to (1) drive a CMV for hire only inside California, and (2) drive a CMV in interstate commerce?
numberItems.explanation: You may drive for hire within California at 18 if you do no interstate commerce; interstate commerce (and any HazMat) requires age 21 (p. 1-2).

numberItems.stem: You paid your CDL application fee. How long is that fee good for?
numberItems.explanation: The application fee is good for 12 months from the application date (p. 1-4).

numberItems.stem: How many tries do you get to pass the knowledge tests on one application, and how long must you wait after failing?
options: 3 tries, with a 14-day wait after each failure
numberItems.explanation: You get 3 attempts at the knowledge tests per application, and there is no waiting period to retake a failed knowledge test (p. 1-4).

numberItems.stem: You were convicted of a traffic violation while driving in Nevada. How soon must you notify your home state DMV?
options: Before the end of the next business day
numberItems.explanation: Notify your home state DMV of any out-of-state conviction within 30 days; the same 30 days applies to telling your employer, on form DL 535 (p. 1-4).

numberItems.stem: Your CDL is suspended. Under the driver duties on page 1-4, when must you tell your employer?
options: Before the end of the next business day
numberItems.explanation: Page 1-4: notify your employer of a suspension, revocation, cancellation or disqualification before the end of the next business day (§1.4 on p. 1-16 says 2 business days). 30 days is the deadline for convictions.

numberItems.stem: You apply for a job as a commercial driver. How many years of commercial driving employment history must you give the employer?
numberItems.explanation: Drivers applying for a driving job must give the employer a 10-year history of commercial driving; you also list every state that licensed you in the past 10 years (p. 1-4).

numberItems.stem: A passenger (P) endorsement is required for a vehicle designed to carry at least how many people, including the driver?
numberItems.explanation: The P endorsement is required for a vehicle with a design capacity of 10 or more people, including the driver (p. 1-5).

numberItems.stem: Not for pay, you tow a fifth-wheel travel trailer. Above what GVWR must you hold a noncommercial Class A license (instead of a CDL)?
numberItems.explanation: Drivers towing, not for pay, a fifth-wheel travel trailer over 15,000 lb GVWR (or a trailer coach over 10,000 lb GVWR) need a noncommercial Class A license, not a CDL (p. 1-7).

numberItems.stem: A farm worker holds a Hazardous Agricultural Materials (HAM) certificate. How often must medical forms (MER and MEC, or DL 546) be sent to DMV?
numberItems.explanation: A HAM certificate holder submits the MER and MEC or Health Questionnaire (DL 546) to DMV every 2 years (p. 1-7).

numberItems.stem: About how long does the CDL vehicle inspection test take?
numberItems.explanation: The vehicle inspection test takes about 40 minutes; basic control skills takes about 30 and the road test about 45–60 (p. 1-11).

numberItems.stem: You want to renew your CDL. A road test is required if it has been expired for more than:
numberItems.explanation: A road test is required to renew a CDL that has been expired for more than 2 years (p. 1-11).

numberItems.stem: When you apply for an original CLP or CDL, your MER and MEC forms must be dated within the last:
numberItems.explanation: The MER and MEC forms must be dated within the last 2 years (p. 1-12).

numberItems.stem: A school bus driver is 67 years old. How often must the driver submit a new medical report to DMV?
numberItems.explanation: School bus drivers 65 and older must submit a new medical report every year (CVC §12517.2; p. 1-12).

numberItems.stem: You will mail your updated MER and MEC to DMV. At least how long before your previous medical expires should you mail them?
numberItems.explanation: You may mail the MER and MEC at least 4 weeks prior to the expiration of your previous medical (p. 1-13).

numberItems.stem: You self-certify as Non-Excepted Intrastate (NA). What restriction appears on your CDL and driver record?
numberItems.explanation: Self-certifying NA puts the CDL Intrastate Only restriction (40/K) on your card and record (p. 1-13).
